10617-within-the-deep-cassell-s-eyes-and.creator: R. Cadwallader Smith
10617-within-the-deep-cassell-s-eyes-and.description: A book by R. Cadwallader Smith. The Herring shoal is a banquet at which the fish-eating sea creatures feed heartily, and man comes along, to spread his nets in the path of the shoal. But what matter a few million Herrings when the sea is packed with billions more! In the North Sea, one shoal was seen which was over four miles long and two miles wide.

22307-the-grammar-school-boys-of-gridley.title: Dick & Co. Start Things Moving
22307-the-grammar-school-boys-of-gridley.creator: H. Irving Hancock
22307-the-grammar-school-boys-of-gridley.description: A book by H. Irving Hancock. "Master Prescott," adjudged the principal, "you may rise in your seat and tell the story to the whole class, myself included. On this dull, rainy day I feel certain that we all need a good laugh."

49735-from-libau-to-tsushima-a-narrative.creator: Russia.

The crews were disheartened by the failures of their comrades at Port Arthur. The beginning of the movements which resulted in the open mutiny in the Black Sea and in the recent mutiny at Cronstadt were developing.

arxiv-1909-09596.title: Optimal Rates for Learning Hidden Tree Structures
arxiv-1909-09596.creator: Konstantinos E. Nikolakakis k.nikolakakis@rutgers.edu, Dionysios S. Kalogerias dionysis@msu.edu, Anand D. Sarwate anand.sarwate@rutgers.edu
arxiv-1909-09596.description: A 2019 arXiv research paper by Konstantinos E. Nikolakakis k.nikolakakis@rutgers.edu, Dionysios S. Kalogerias dionysis@msu.edu, Anand D. Sarwate anand.sarwate@rutgers.edu. We provide high probability finite sample complexity guarantees for hidden non-parametric structure learning of tree-shaped graphical models, whose hidden and observable nodes are discrete random variables with either finite or countable alphabets.

arxiv-2011-04743.title: Adversarial Semantic Collisions
arxiv-2011-04743.creator: Congzheng Song, Alexander M. Rush, Vitaly Shmatikov
arxiv-2011-04743.description: Abstract We study semantic collisions : texts that are semantically unrelated but judged as similar by NLP models. We develop gradient-based approaches for generating semantic collisions and demonstrate that state-of-the-art models for many tasks which rely on analyzing the meaning and similarity of texts—including paraphrase identification, document retrieval, response suggestion, and extractive summarization—are vulnerable to semantic collisions.

arxiv-2104-15030.title: KEK-TH-2322 Sharpening the Boundaries Between Flux Landscape and Swampland by Tadpole Charge
arxiv-2104-15030.creator: Keiya Ishiguro and Hajime Otsuka, *[20pt] Graduate University for Advanced Studies (Sokendai),1-1 Oho, Tsukuba, Ibaraki 305-0801, Japan.
arxiv-2104-15030.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Keiya Ishiguro and Hajime Otsuka, *[20pt] Graduate University for Advanced Studies (Sokendai),1-1 Oho, Tsukuba, Ibaraki 305-0801, Japan.. Abstract We investigate the vacuum structure of four-dimensional effective theory arising from Type IIB flux compactifications on a mirror of the rigid Calabi-Yau threefold, corresponding to a T-dual of the DeWolfe-Giryavets-Kachru-Taylor model in Type IIA flux compactifications.

arxiv-2105-12948.title: Case for quarkyoniclike matter from a constituent quark model
arxiv-2105-12948.creator: Aaron Park, Kie Sang Jeong, Su Houng Lee
arxiv-2105-12948.description: Abstract Based on the fact that the constituent quark model reproduces the recent lattice result on baryon-baryon repulsion at short distance and that it includes the quark dynamics with confinement, we analyze to what extent the quarkyonic modes appear in the phase space of baryons as one increases the density before only quark dynamics and hence deconfinement occurs.

arxiv-2205-00166.title: Geodesic deviation on symmetry axis in Taub–NUT metric
arxiv-2205-00166.creator: V.P. Vandeev, A.N. Semenova
arxiv-2205-00166.description: Abstract An important aspect of General Relativity is to study properties of geodesics. A useful tool for describing geodesic behavior is the geodesic deviation equation. It allows to describe the tidal properties of gravitating objects through the curvature of spacetime. This article focuses on the study of the axially symmetric Taub–NUT metric.

arxiv-2205-05200.title: Constraining the Local Pulsar Population with the Cosmic-Ray Positron Fraction
arxiv-2205-05200.creator: and Dan Hooper
arxiv-2205-05200.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by and Dan Hooper. Observations of the TeV halos associated with nearby pulsars indicate that these objects inject significant fluxes of very high-energy electron-positrons pairs into the interstellar medium (ISM), thereby likely providing the dominant contribution to the cosmic-ray positron flux. In this paper, we use the cosmic-ray positron fraction as measured by the AMS-02 Collaboration to constrain the characteristics of the local pulsar population.

arxiv-2209-03453.title: Performance of the Upgraded VERITAS Stellar Intensity Interferometer (VSII)
arxiv-2209-03453.creator: David B. Kieda, the VERITAS Collaboration
arxiv-2209-03453.description: Abstract The VERITAS Imaging Air Cherenkov Telescope array (IACT) was augmented in 2019 with high-speed focal plane electronics to create a new Stellar Intensity Interferometry (SII) observational capability (VERITAS-SII, or VSII). VSII operates during bright moon periods, providing high angular resolution observations ( < < 1 mas) in the B photometric band using idle telescope time.

arxiv-2209-08041.title: T. Blum, P. Winter
arxiv-2209-08041.creator: T. Bhattacharya, T.Y. Chen, V. Cirigliano, D. DeMille, A. Geraci, N.R. Hutzler, T.M. Ito, D. Kaplan, O. Kim, R. Lehnert, W.M. Morse, Y.K. Semertzidis
arxiv-2209-08041.description: Abstract Chapter 0 Fundamental Physics in Small Experiments 1 Introduction High energy physics aims to understand the fundamental laws of particles and their interactions at both the largest and smallest scales of the universe. This typically means probing very high energies or large distances or using high-intensity beams, which often requires large-scale experiments on earth or in space.

arxiv-2511-06933.title: Transformed Fréchet Means for Robust Estimation in Hadamard Spaces
arxiv-2511-06933.creator: Christof Schötz
arxiv-2511-06933.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Christof Schötz. We establish finite-sample error bounds in expectation for transformed Fréchet means in Hadamard spaces under minimal assumptions. Transformed Fréchet means provide a unifying framework encompassing classical and robust notions of central tendency in metric spaces. Instead of minimizing squared distances as for the classical 2-Fréchet mean, we consider transformations of the distance that are nondecreasing, convex, and have a concave derivative. This class spans a continuum between median and classical mean.

arxiv-2511-16518.title: MiMo-Embodied: X-Embodied Foundation Model Technical Report
arxiv-2511-16518.creator: Xiaomi Embodied Intelligence Team
arxiv-2511-16518.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Xiaomi Embodied Intelligence Team. We open-source MiMo-Embodied, the first cross-embodied foundation model to successfully integrate and achieve state-of-the-art performance in both Autonomous Driving and Embodied AI. MiMo-Embodied sets new records across 17 embodied AI benchmarks in Task Planning , Affordance Prediction and Spatial Understanding , while also excelling in 12 autonomous driving benchmarks across Environmental Perception , Status Prediction , and Driving Planning . Across these tasks, MiMo-Embodied significantly outperforms existing open-source, closed-source, and specialized baselines.

pmc-10735380.title: ECONOMICS OF LONG-TERM SERVICES AND SUPPORTS: PRODUCTION, DEMAND, AND COSTS
pmc-10735380.creator: Christine Bishop
pmc-10735380.description: Economic analysis of the production, demand, and utilization of long-term services and supports (LTSS) can generate insights for public policy. This symposium presents a range of economics approaches to LTSS, with policy implications. The first paper considers in-home care as a production process, estimating the impact of various mixes of informal care and paid formal care on health outcomes.

pmc-11490671.title: Overlap of frailty and malnutrition as prognosticators in older patients with heart failure
pmc-11490671.creator: Takuro Abe, Kentaro Jujo, Yudai Fujimoto, Daichi Maeda, Yuki Ogasahara, Kazuya Saito, Hiroshi Saito, Kentaro Iwata, Masaaki Konishi, Takeshi Kitai, Takatoshi Kasai, Hiroshi Wada, Shin-ichi Momomura, Nobuyuki Kagiyama, Kentaro Kamiya, Emi Maekawa, Yuya Matsue
pmc-11490671.description: BackgroundPhysical frailty and malnutrition coexist in older patients with heart failure (HF) and form a vicious cycle exacerbating each other and can cause poor clinical outcomes. We aimed to clarify the association of prevalence of physical frailty and malnutrition and clinical outcomes in hospitalized patients with HF.

pmc-11514193.title: Effects of acetazolamide on sleep disordered breathing in pulmonary vascular disease: a randomised controlled trial
pmc-11514193.creator: Esther I. Schwarz, Stéphanie Saxer, Mona Lichtblau, Simon R. Schneider, Julian Müller, Laura Mayer, Konrad E. Bloch, Silvia Ulrich
pmc-11514193.description: BackgroundPatients with pulmonary vascular disease (PVD) often suffer from nocturnal hypoxaemia, but also from sleep apnoea. Short-term use of acetazolamide increases ventilation due to metabolic acidosis and also reduces loop gain. We investigated whether prolonged use of acetazolamide improves sleep disordered breathing in PVD.

pmc-11598311.title: Novel Glycidyl Carbamate Functional Epoxy Resin Using Hydroxyl-Terminated Polybutadiene
pmc-11598311.creator: Hae-Chan Kim, Sun-Jae Moon, Yong-Rok Kwon, Seok-kyu Moon, Dah-hee Kim, Dong-Hyun Kim, Dan Rosu
pmc-11598311.description: Herein, a novel glycidyl carbamate functional epoxy resin (GCE) is synthesized by the additional reaction of the isocyanate group of tolylene diisocyanate (TDI) with the hydroxyl group of hydroxyl-terminated polybutadiene (HTPB) and glycidol. The successful synthesis of the GCE is confirmed by FT-IR and 1H NMR spectroscopy.

pmc-11611061.description: This study evaluated the protective effects of silica nanoparticles (SiNPs) derived from melon seed husk ash against the neurotoxic effects of common environmental pollutants, aluminum (Al), nickel (Ni), and their combination in Wistar rats. pmc-12420806.description: In recent years, there has been a rapid increase in the incidence of thyroid carcinoma (TC). pmc-13055810.title: Cohort Study of Initial Diuretic Dosing and Outcomes Among Patients Hospitalized for Congestive Heart Failure: Insights From the Cardiovascular Quality Improvement and Care Innovation Consortium
pmc-13055810.creator: Naureen Qadri, Erica Kwok, Larissa Stanberry, Chelsey Thomas, Stephanie J Irausquin, Divya Gupta, Joseph E Ebinger, Ty J Gluckman, R Kannan Mutharasan, Abhinav Goyal, Nicholas K Brownell, Benjamin M Scirica, P Michael Ho, Sandeep R Das, William Downey, Steven M Bradley

Initial diuretic dose was categorized relative to home dose in furosemide equivalents.

pmc-13351778.creator: Quinton E. A. Sirianni, Nitzan Letko Khait, Adam Forman, Edward A. Armstrong, Karim Fouad, Molly S. Shoichet
pmc-13351778.description: Hydrogels are of great interest for the delivery of protein therapeutics as they obviate the denaturing shear forces and/or organic solvents common to other delivery systems. Dextrin, a polysaccharide derived from starch, has been largely ignored in the design of hydrogels, yet is biodegradable and can be modified to allow in situ gelation after injection by click‐crosslinking.

pmc-13466870.title: Internet Addiction, Mental Health Help-Seeking, and Mental Health Problems Among Chinese Adolescents: Repeated Cross-Sectional Study
pmc-13466870.creator: Afei Qin, Meiqi Wang, Lianlong Yu, Suyun Li, Zhaolu Liu, Shoujuan Zheng, Ziming Shao, Cuixia Lv, Long Sun, Matthew Balcarras
pmc-13466870.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundInternet addiction (IA) has been consistently associated with adverse mental health outcomes, but less is known about whether adolescents with IA seek mental health support, and whether associations between help-seeking and mental health problems differ across pathways.ObjectiveThis study aimed to describe mental health help-seeking patterns across internet use and IA status, and examine the independent and interactive associations of IA and help-seeking with mental health problems.MethodsData were drawn from 2 repeated cross-sectional surveys conducted in Shandong Province in 2023 and 2024.

pmc-13513352.description: Biological control strategies are increasingly being explored as sustainable alternatives for managing rice blast disease caused by Magnaporthe oryzae.
